title: Combination Sum IV
summary: Count ordered sequences of values from nums whose sum equals target.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–200 distinct integers in [1,1000]. 1 ≤ target ≤ 1000. The answer fits signed 32-bit range. Intermediate counts may need wider arithmetic or safe saturation.
contractDetails.output-checking: Compare the exact ordered-sequence count. Saturating intermediate nonnegative counts at the maximum permitted answer preserves every valid final result.

statement: Count ordered sequences of values from nums whose sum equals target. A value may be used repeatedly. Changing the order produces a different sequence unless the resulting sequence is identical.

examples.explanation: No sum using only even values is odd.
Only three copies of 2 can reach the target.

constraints: 1–200 distinct integers in [1,1000]. 1 ≤ target ≤ 1000. The answer fits signed 32-bit range. Intermediate counts may need wider arithmetic or safe saturation.
hints: Conceptual: The final value leaves a smaller sum to construct.
Directional: Store the count for each smaller total.
Implementation: Seed the empty sequence at sum zero. For each total, add the counts obtained by choosing each possible final value.
complexityAnalysis: O(target × length(nums)) time and O(target) auxiliary space.
